home.heroSub: An initiative of the Department of Consumer Affairs to make procurement scheduling predictable for every farmer.
home.visionQuote: When the farmer of India is strong, the nation is strong. Technology must reach the farm and save the farmer's time.
home.visionAttribution: — Vision of the Prime Minister of India for farmer welfare
home.visionBody: Kisan Sahayak Portal takes that vision to the procurement centre: know your centre, book a slot in your own language, and arrive only when it is your turn.
home.langBody: Every screen, notification and error message is designed for multi-lingual delivery. The portal currently ships English, Hindi, Telugu and Bengali, with more Indian languages planned.
home.currentBody: Rice Procurement · Kharif 2026 is currently open in mapped service areas. Check Slot Booking after logging in.
home.what1Body: See procurement schedules for your area and reserve a time before you travel.
home.what2Body: Capacity is checked on the server. If a slot is full, the portal says so.
home.what3Body: Follow procurement and payment status from one place.

about.title: About the Kisan Sahayak Portal
about.body: The Kisan Sahayak Portal is a digital service for procurement scheduling and farmer communication. Farmers can register, verify their contact details, view procurement information, see eligible centres based on their service area and book an available slot. Government staff use the administration portal to configure centres, publish capacity and send updates.
about.purpose: The portal is designed to reduce unnecessary travel and waiting by making the next step clear. A booking is not a guarantee of procurement outcome or payment. Those statuses are shown separately and updated only when the relevant operational record is available.
about.how: Registration → nearby centre → slot → confirmation → procurement update → payment update.
about.dataTitle: Why we ask for your details
about.dataBody: Your contact details create and secure your account and send booking updates. Your address and pincode help us show the procurement centres configured for your service area. Identity information is used only for the purpose stated on this portal and handled with appropriate security controls.
